Container.Name: meshsimple
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Meshtastic monitoring app. Displays a live map of all mesh nodes, a node list, and persistent channel 0 messaging (send and receive). Connects to your Meshtastic device over TCP/WiFi.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the meshsimple web interface.

Config.Name: Meshtastic Host
Config.Description: IP address or hostname of your Meshtastic device (e.g. 192.168.1.79).

Config.Name: Meshtastic Port
Config.Description: TCP port of your Meshtastic device. Default is 4403.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database.

Config.Name: Reaction Emojis
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of emojis available for message reactions (e.g. 👍,👎,❤️,😂,😮). Defaults to 5 emojis if not set.

Container.Changes:
### 2026-10-08 - Add beta and alpha firmware channels; downgrades now need explicit confirmation - The firmware version in the sidebar now opens the firmware page, so you can switch channels even when no update is available - WiFi firmware update now waits for the device to come back up, instead of failing after a fixed 10-second delay - Fix messages queued on the device while disconnected showing the wrong time after reconnect - Fix hop count showing the wrong value (it was using hops remaining)
### 2026-08-22 - Add firmware version display on your node, with an indicator when an update is available - Add one-click WiFi firmware update (requires device firmware 2.7.18 or newer) - Fix app becoming slow/unresponsive for a while after startup - Fix app not automatically reconnecting after the device disconnects
### 2026-05-05 - Show received timestamp alongside hop count in message sender hover tooltip - Use over-the-air receive time (rxTime) for more accurate message timestamps
### 2026-04-28 - Fix REACTION_EMOJIS env var being ignored
### 2026-04-20 - Add reply-to: click any message to quote it in your reply - Add emoji reactions with configurable emoji set via REACTION_EMOJIS variable - Add emoji picker on compose input
### 2026-04-13 - Show active vs total node count with breakdown tooltip
### 2026-04-11 - Fix timezone handling — timestamps now always serialised as UTC - Fix packet receive issue caused by getMetadata ping - Switch map tile layer based on light/dark theme - Show hop count tooltip on message sender names
### 2026-04-10 - Mobile responsive layout - Node sort dropdown - UI improvements: branding, message dividers, node activity filtering
### 2026-04-08 - Initial release
